scope: fresh per-spot training procedure check; tiny explicit ranges; no zero-shot or global strength claim
selection_reason: ordinary default retained after issue 2; lower final development median in three of four known games
selection: PCG64; sample four ordered board cards; accept only texture/novelty constraints; sample eight distinct remaining cards for two combos per seat; integer combo weights 1..3
dry_rule: three flop ranks separated pairwise by at least 3 with three distinct suits; all four board ranks distinct; ace treated high
wet_rule: three distinct flop ranks within a span of 4 and exactly two flop suits; all four board ranks distinct; ace treated high
novelty_rule: reject any prior or selected (sorted flop ranks, turn rank) signature, regardless of suits; never inspect strategic outcomes
reporting: all cases, seeds, checkpoints, failures, overshoot, initialization and subsequent coverage; no replacement or extension after a miss
reference_use: post-training native value and best-response audit only; no reference input into strategies
